paper_reference.inspiration: X-13 conservative edge admission, QGBDT lower-quantile utility
paper_reference.equivalence_claim: algorithm-inspired adaptation, not an exact X-13 reproduction

expected_offloaded_compute_demand_gflops.scope: UE4 configured expected offered demand, computed from actually executed routing probabilities at task arrivals

decision.budget_filter: A_safe = {p in candidates: configured_task_rate_per_s * compute_gflop_per_task * p <= budget_gflops}
decision.profile_validation: Validate 20 tasks/s and 0.05 GFLOP/task against the run manifest; never estimate a safety limit from a lower demand quantile.
decision.learned_selection: argmax_p Q_0.20(U | public features, p) over A_safe
decision.tie_break: largest feasible p within 1e-9 of the best predicted utility
decision.cold_start: largest analytically feasible p; label the decision rules_only, not QGBDT inference
decision.invalid_or_stale_input: emit no new action and report not_evaluable; existing leased policy persists until normal expiry or explicit withdrawal; an empty decision is not rollback and gives no compliance guarantee
decision.budget_semantics: Expected-demand contract only. The realized route-count workload is separately reported with its window and is not a hard per-task quota.

learner.parameter_provenance: predeclared implementation defaults, not settings reported by the paper
learner.inputs: delivered public observations and validated task-profile metadata only

label.name: measured_service_utility
label.zero_generated: skip; do not create a zero-utility label
label.scope: all generated tasks, local and offloaded; failures and overdue pending tasks remain in the denominator
label.penalty_disclosure: Deadline penalties define training utility only; actual completed latency remains a separate KPI, N/A when no completions.

learner.small_data_limit: The predicted lower quantile is a conservative score, not a calibrated confidence bound or a QoS guarantee. With two arrivals per cohort and p=0.5, P(all-local)=0.25: the 0.20 utility quantile can tie p=0 and reproduce the analytic tie-break. Do not retune alpha merely to force a learned gain.
learner.compute: small CPU fits and inference; no new GPU dependency
learner.artifact: versioned plain JSON containing feature/label schema, actual fit parameters, retained measured rows, initial prediction and additive trees; no pickle or RF relabelled as QGBDT
learner.feature_timing: Capture delivered features before requesting an action; use only already available recent mature cohorts, never the future outcome used as its label.

online_collection.mode: isolated training without X01 or other competing controllers
online_collection.action_window: hold until actual execution/ownership confirmation and one complete future cohort has matured through its task deadlines
online_collection.exploration: alternate only budget-feasible actions 0 and 0.5; at least six measured rows per action
online_collection.data_shortfall: keep rules_only status and report insufficient measured data; do not fabricate samples or silently extend the budget
invalidations: executed p differs from requested p
handover changes controlled scope during the cohort
mixed action within the measured cohort
online_collection.joint_evaluation: frozen model; no new training samples or fits; random arbitration and rejected requests are conflict evidence, never training labels

validation.rules_only_ablation: compare against the analytic largest-feasible-p guard before claiming value from learning
validation.structural_M1: Distinct active xApps request unequal ue_offload_fraction values for ue_4 in overlapping valid control intervals; record the contender set before random mitigation. Shared field names alone do not pass.
validation.operational_conflict: Record any energy or expected-demand contract violation before/after mitigation only from actual executed-policy and KPI evidence. A random-mitigated run satisfying both contracts is a mitigation success, not a failed structural-conflict case.
learned_app_evidence: actual QGBDT fitting on measured rows
validation.native_scenario: existing six-UE radio/traffic/DRX/MEC setup; explicit 0.75 GFLOP/s UE4 operator quota; no physical congestion claim
validation.scope_limit: Actual online fit and frozen four-arm 1 s calibration completed; structural M1 observed. Random mitigation met budget/QoS, missed the energy contract. No learned superiority, long-run generalization or M5 impossibility claim.

seed_roles.note: Predeclare these case roles; do not claim that a seed is globally unseen by X01 without auditing its earlier provenance.

validation.random_mitigation: Each conflicting decision selects exactly one unchanged valid candidate uniformly, using independent reproducible randomness; actual execution matches the selected request and unrelated actions remain intact.
validation.post_mitigation_reporting: Report whether both, one, or neither intent contract passes; do not require random mitigation to cause KPI harm.

realized_kpi.name: realized_offloaded_compute_demand_gflops
realized_kpi.classification: stochastic diagnostic; do not classify a short-window overshoot alone as a guard failure or conflict

mitigation.trigger: distinct active xApps propose unequal values for the same target UE and RCP in overlapping valid control intervals
mitigation.sampling: uniform over unique valid proposing xApp IDs; two candidates each have probability 0.5; N candidates each have probability 1/N
mitigation.choice_unit: one atomic candidate request for the conflict key (UE ID, RCP); in this case select the complete scalar ue_offload_fraction value unchanged. Do not randomly choose or discard a whole cell ConfigAction/map.
mitigation.unrelated_actions: preserve other UE/cell requests and independent nonconflicting fields, including native DRX; do not average or combine competing values of the conflicted RCP
mitigation.validity: ordinary schema/range/scope/timing validation applies before sampling; do not exclude a contender merely because its action violates the other xApp intent
mitigation.equal_or_single_candidate: equal requested values are not an M1 conflict; deploy the agreed action, or the sole valid candidate, without consuming a random draw
mitigation.ordering: canonical stable order by unique xApp instance ID; duplicate refreshes never add sampling weight
mitigation.hold: draw once per explicit [start,end) 100 ms deployment decision window; keep the chosen request ID and value until that window ends or the request becomes invalid; identical refreshes and slot-level retransmissions never redraw
mitigation.invalidation: expire the selection on request expiry, withdrawal, invalid scope or handover; validate current candidates before any fresh deployment
mitigation.rng: dedicated mitigation RNG, independent of traffic, channel, mobility, exploration and learner RNGs
mitigation.randomization_unit: deterministic per-conflict-key streams derived from mitigation seed and stable scope identity; record decision index and exact draw
mitigation.priority: priority does not choose among valid directly conflicting candidates in this policy
mitigation.lease_consistency: Implement random resolution on sanitized current and held per-UE requests. Existing RuleLeases priority reconciliation and whole-cell maps must not overwrite the random result or discard unrelated UID values; retain request validity and selection-generation metadata.
log: all candidate instance IDs and unchanged actions
mitigation seed, stream key, decision index and random draw
actual execution acknowledgement and reported policy
raw request IDs -> conflict/window draw -> selected UID/RCP request -> submitted control ID -> execution acknowledgement/policy timestamp
mitigation.fairness: 50/50 is per-decision sampling probability, not guaranteed equal finite-sample win counts, deployment time, or energy; report each separately
mitigation.outcome: random mitigation may preserve both intent contracts; report structural conflict before mitigation and actual KPI compliance after mitigation separately
mitigation.window_validity: At 0.5 ms/slot, 100 ms spans 200 slots; inclusive effective_until_slot must be window_end_slot-1, further limited by the source request validity.
mitigation.queued_controls: carry mitigation window/generation and validity through submission and delayed application; an old-window queued action must not overwrite a newer selected winner
mitigation.no_valid_candidate: explicitly restore the matched native parameter through the ordinary control path and confirm execution; message expiry or cache deletion alone does not undo a persistent applied value
